name: Sturdy Finance
fix_description: Before calling IPriceOracleGetter(oracle).getAssetPrice() for Balancer/Curve LP tokens in calculateUserAccountData, verify the external pool is not mid-transaction by calling its reentrancy guard check (e.g., Balancer VaultReentrancyLib.ensureNotInVaultContext()). Without this check, an attacker can trigger a read-only reentrancy from a pool callback where getRate() returns an inflated value due to intermediate pool state.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC uses a non-obvious read-only reentrancy against Balancer exit flow to manipulate oracle-dependent collateral valuation inside Sturdy, then chains collateral toggling, withdrawal, self-liquidation, and liquidity unwinding across Aave, Balancer, Curve, and Sturdy. It requires deep understanding of protocol internals, LP pricing/oracle interactions, and multi-contract state timing, which would likely take an experienced auditor well over 2 hours to reproduce from scratch.
